title: editMetadata
body:
## editMetadata

Write new copies of photographs (a new copy of the same container: JPEG, TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP or HEIF with existing Exif and XMP items) with their title, description, keywords, creator list, copyright, rights URL, rating, city or country set, cleared or (for keywords) added to and removed from. Every original is captured byte for byte and never modified; each output is published only after independent readback of every requested value or absence, a byte-for-byte comparison of the encoded image and everything that is not an editable metadata slot (for a JPEG its frame header, tables, scans and rendering segments; for another container an offset-free fingerprint of strips, tiles, chunks or items), and a native before/after diff that allows only the plan targets and declared side effects. Items that cannot be written are refused or fail individually with an outcome document at their stable artifact slot.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Not a way to write raw ExifTool tags: only the nine catalogue fields can be edited, by intent (set, clear, add, remove).
- Text is exact: never normalised, trimmed, truncated or transliterated; a form that cannot hold it exactly is removed (or the item refused), never cut.
- An existing IPTC character set is never changed over text it would reinterpret; legacy Latin-1 text keeps its meaning and the IPTC form of the edited field is removed and reported instead.
- Proof P is about bytes, not pixels: it says nothing about image authenticity, provenance or how a program renders the picture.
- Artifact slot i is the i-th item: a refused item keeps its slot as an outcome document (never an image), so binding that index to an image consumer fails instead of selecting another photo.
- In a HEIF file only Exif and XMP items that already exist are edited; an edit that would create one is refused with HEIF_METADATA_ITEM_CREATION_UNSUPPORTED (a named limit of ExifTool 13.55 on the tested fixtures), and PNG, WebP and HEIF have no IPTC slot (declared loss iptcNotAvailableInContainer).

Native binding: `one perl exiftool -config "" process per item: -GROUP:TAG=value assignments chosen by the planner from catalogue write data (XMP, IPTC and EXIF forms of the requested fields; never authored) -o stage/ID.jpg captured/ID.jpg`. Output kind: `["image","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. | `policies` | How to resolve choices the data cannot decide. The accepted members depend on the operation: editMetadata (iptc, otherLanguages, exifEncoding, companionLoss), correctTime (sourceConflicts, preferFamily, subSecond, uncorrectedItems), setLocation (staleCompanions, xmp, createExif, altitudeNotExpressible, removeDirection, uncorrectedItems) and geotagFromTrack (those of setLocation plus gpsStamp and maxSpeedMetersPerSecond). Every member is optional; the effective plan echoes all of them with their defaults. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"iptc":{"type":"enum","values":["ifPresent","always"]},"otherLanguages":{"type":"enum","values":["keep","remove","refuse"]},"exifEncoding":{"type":"enum","values":["utf8","ascii"]},"companionLoss":{"type":"enum","values":["removeCompanion","refuse"]}}}` | omitted |
